name: Should I choose ceramic tile or natural stone marble for a kitchen backsplash?

mainEntity.name: Should I choose ceramic tile or natural stone marble for a kitchen backsplash?

acceptedAnswer.text: Porcelain and ceramic tiles offer easy cleaning, stain resistance, and minimal maintenance, making them ideal for heavy-cooking households. Marble and other natural stones bring a high-end, classic appearance with unique veining, but they are porous and require periodic sealing to resist grease splatters, acid stains, and moisture. Additionally, smaller mosaic tiles feature significantly more grout lines that require ongoing maintenance compared to large-format tiles. Balancing your daily cooking style against how much time you want to spend maintaining stone and grout will help clarify the best option for your kitchen.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ceramic and porcelain offer superior stain resistance with minimal upkeep, while natural stone marble delivers distinct, upscale beauty but requires ongoing sealing and care.
